violated_contract: Production audio capture must use the same PCM conversion implementation whose rounding, clamping and nonfinite-input behavior is verified by the shared core tests. Context for Claude's microphone and system-audio callbacks instead had independent Float-to-Int16 loops, so passing C++ encoder tests did not establish the behavior of captured audio.
canonical_prevention: Route platform converter buffers through the shared pointer-based PCM encoder and derive meters and watchdog magnitudes from the encoded bytes. Exercise that production pointer seam with asymmetric rounding, clipping and NaN samples, and test signed-minimum peak magnitude in the portable core.
